About.title: Biography
body: Kambiz Akhbari (born 1984) is a freelance professional photographer, filmmaker, and art director. Trained in computer software engineering, he began working in design and graphics at seventeen and in photography at nineteen.
He has directed and edited music videos for leading Iranian artists, including Yas, 25Band, and The Ways. He is the founder of Lead34, a production company and label based in Istanbul.

Alongside his commercial and editorial work, he is a sought-after mentor in videography, photography, and editing, including mobile-first workflows, and has trained a large number of students who now work with the best in the market.
